current.note: Version tracking is unstarted; the implementation already exists in the 6.5.0 baseline and no component version has been accepted.

versioning.policy: 0.1.0 is the first explicit contract set; 0.1.x refines it; a minor increase expands the contract set before 1.0; each component and composition independently earns 1.0 only after tests, joint validation, and explicit human acceptance.
untrackedScope: The overall UploadDiscToShelf composition has no assigned component version in this proposal.
Other Experience components remain unknown and are not assigned placeholder versions.

include: A source-ordered packed trie indexes all canonical mold names. A single * consumes exactly one Unicode code point; a trailing run of * is redundant prefix syntax; adjacent ** elsewhere is invalid. Manufacturer-first queries filter the name-index ordinals through the packed manufacturer dictionary.
One compact runtime catalog carries mold names, manufacturers, and the four flight values. The authoritative catalog bytes and exact source-row identity remain separate provenance bindings.

Search suggestions do not write PxC. Explicit selection, or direct save of an address-bearing draft, materializes only that selected seed Part at a stable address with catalog version/source provenance.
A saved Disc retains the exact seed Part and resolved facts it captured; later catalog changes or seed corrections do not rewrite the saved Disc snapshot.
The static full and lite catalogs remain build inputs; the browser receives the packed generated runtime asset and integrity checks, not a duplicate source catalog or a world-sized PxC catalog.
exclude: Photo crop, renderer, or layout redesign.
A browser query-time threshold until the user approves one.

requirements.statement: The composed UploadDiscToShelf path queries a packed source-ordered mold-name trie, supports exactly-one-codepoint * matching, treats trailing * runs as redundant, rejects adjacent ** elsewhere, and preserves source order.
Manufacturer-first input is supported by filtering name-trie source ordinals with the packed manufacturer dictionary; reversed token order and typo correction are not part of this contract.
One runtime asset supplies name, manufacturer, and four flight facts; selected Parts retain stable ID, catalog version, exact authoritative catalog SHA-256, and source-row identity.
Search is read-only with respect to PxC; selection/direct save materializes only the selected mold, and prior saved Disc snapshots remain stable.

The mold control stays disabled until its catalog and event handlers are ready. Missing/corrupt assets leave the page mountable with a visible retry message and unsafe selection/save controls disabled; invalid wildcard syntax clears the prior selection and reports the error.

potentialBadThings.risk: Trie ordinals could point at the wrong source row if the build index and packed record table use different ordering.
A malformed query could leave an old hidden selection available to save or display.
A missing or corrupt packed asset could reject the entire module graph before an error state mounts.
Preloading all 724 seed Parts into PxC would store catalog state unrelated to the player’s selected discs.
Changing catalog bytes or a selected seed correction could silently alter a previously saved Disc.
Separate packed name and detail indices could disagree on manufacturer, facts, or source order.
Node timings and compressed bytes do not establish browser startup-to-interactable, first visible suggestion, or main-thread stall behavior.

openRequirements.note: A browser measurement must include navigation, packed-asset fetch/hash/open/decode, event-handler readiness, and first accepted user action.
Measure real input through first correct visible suggestion after paint, including an attempted input during startup; the UI now remains disabled until handlers are ready.
Collect browser main-thread stall/long-task observations under an explicitly named local browser/cache/CPU context.
The 1–1.5 second range is illustrative only. It is not an approved threshold and Node timing is not a substitute.
Local code and automated checks do not constitute human acceptance of this component or the complete UploadDiscToShelf composition.
